note: Additive current evidence for configuration history and construction-chain intelligence. A1/A2 non-execution support and B project signals never close an execution scope.

signals.title: Current Edison compliance filing confirms 88.5 MW configuration
signals.note: MASE metadata for Edison Rinnovabili's 31 July 2026 compliance report explicitly states that Andretta-Bisaccia was updated with a power reduction to 88.5 MW and turbine replacement. The older top-level procedure title still shows 118.80 MW; the latest project-specific compliance filing is therefore retained as the current configuration signal rather than treating the stale title as a second live configuration.

signals.title: Compliance documentation supports works-start preparation
signals.note: The same MASE metadata states that the filing includes technical support for avvio lavori. This strengthens near-term mobilisation timing but does not by itself prove that civil works have started or identify any executing contractor.

relations.scope: Direct EGM Project content documents active Serra Giannina site follow-up at Torre 8, including assembly-area layout, WTG foundation excavation, blade-support areas and heavy-move planning. This confirms project-specific technical presence only and does not attribute Civil BoP, foundations, erection or logistics execution to EGM.

A D'Agostino employee publicly describes participation in the Serra Giannina project alongside RWE and refers to D'Agostino's civil-infrastructure renewable construction capability; company-attributed recruitment notices also seek site staff specifically for Serra Giannina. This is a strong project-specific mobilisation signal, but no direct company/developer award statement has yet been found, so no Civil BoP or other execution scope is closed.

signals.title: Torre 8 foundation and assembly-area works visibly active
signals.note: EGM Project's direct article shows the foundation excavation already formed and assembly/storage areas prepared at Serra Giannina Torre 8, confirming an active construction phase without identifying the executing package contractor.

signals.title: D'Agostino project-specific mobilisation signal
signals.note: Employee and recruitment evidence ties D'Agostino to Serra Giannina, but the evidence ceiling remains B until RWE, D'Agostino or a primary project document explicitly states the awarded execution scope.
